programme.desc: Johnny Depp. Pasi shndërrohet në një vampir dhe groposet nga ish e dashura e tij, Barnabas rikthehet pas 200 vjetësh, në vitin 1972... Por gjerat në qytetin e tij, duket sa kanë ndryshuar tërësisht.

programme.title: S1E3 - Të Gjithë Cmënden pas Rejmondit
programme.desc: Rei Barone i ka të gjitha në jetë: një familje të madhe, një punë të mirë dhe një shtëpi të bukur. Problemi i vetëm i tij janë prindërit dhe vëllai i tij xheloz, të cilët jetojnë në anën tjetër të rrugës. Telashet nuk kanë të sosur në këtë familje të madhe, por Reimondi ka mësuar si t’i përballojë ato.

programme.title: Kënga ime e dashurisë
programme.desc: Xhejni është një grua që fshihet nga jeta pasi një aksident e lë në karrige me rrota. Xhoi është i dashuri i saj që flet me fantazma dhe engjëj që askush tjetër s’i sheh apo dëgjon. Kur ai lexon në gazetë që autori i tij i preferuar do të flasë në Nju Orleans, bind Xhinin të shkojë me të. Rrugës ata njohin Billin, një grua e re që është në kërkim të burrit të saj të zhdukur. Udhëtarët hasin shumë pengesa dhe takojnë ”engjëj” dhe ”djaj” të ndryshëm gjatë rrugës. A do të arrijnë në kohë për aktivitetin më të rëndësishëm të jetës së Xhejnit?

programme.title: Journeys In India
programme.sub-title: Agra and its environs

programme.title: Journeys In India

Release Year: 2019 Director: Nitesh Tiwari Awards: 2020 Nominee Screen Award - Best Film Critics, 2020 Nominee Filmfare Award -Best Film, 2019 Winner Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Award - Favorite Movie, 2020 Winner Regional Award - Best Feature Film in Hindi, 2020 Nominee Popular Award - Best Story.

programme.desc: Dhanlaxmi belittles her disabled husband, Kanwal. His mention of 'Jamini' leads them to Rani. Rocky and Rani fall in love but face family conflicts. Release Year: 2023 Director: Karan Johar Awards: 69th Filmfare Awards, IIFA Awards 2024, Zee Cine and Other Popular Awards.

programme.title: Garam Masala
programme.desc: Watch the hilarious outcome as two casanova photographers try to out-do each other in their personal and professional lives. Release Year: 2005 Director: Priyadarshan Awards: 2006 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Comic Actor- Akshay Kumar.

programme.title: Fighter
programme.desc: A reckless yet brilliant squadron leader and his team of elite fighter pilots face mortal dangers and inner demons as they unite for a deadly mission. programme.title: Kya Love Story Hai

programme.title: Apurva

programme.title: Ghar
programme.desc: Vikas regains his senses and finds himself in hospital with a head wound with Aarti too in the same hospital after being assaulted. Release Year: 1978 Director: Manik Chatterjee.

programme.title: The Great Samshuddin Family
programme.desc: An eccentric family navigates hilarious daily mishaps, domestic squabbles, and heartwarming moments, constantly finding funny ways to stay united despite their endless personal differences. Release Year: 2025 Director: Anusha Rizvi.

programme.title: Raghuveer
programme.desc: Raghuveer is arrested and imprisoned on false charges. His police officer brother, Ravi, is enraged and severs all ties with him. Release Year: 1995 Director: K. Pappu.

Things take an unexpected turn when Nilofar gets divorced and Afaque offers her a job at his company. Release Year: 1982 Director: B.R. Chopra Awards: 1983 WinnerFilmfare Award- Best Playback Singer Female- Salma Agha.

Release Year: 2018 Director: Siddharth P. Malhotra Awards: 2018 Winner IFF Award- Best ActreSS- Rani Mukerji.

programme.title: Abcd

programme.title: Dilwale
programme.desc: Raj and Meera reunite years later, reigniting love but facing past wounds, misunderstandings and emotional conflicts.

programme.desc: Six people encounter wild jungle animals and danger at every turn while racing against time to find a hidden stash of 500 million rupees. Release Year: 2019 Director: Indra Kumar Awards: 2020 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award -The 100 Crore Club.

programme.title: Saamrajya

programme.desc: Dil Bechara.

programme.sub-title: Mannat, a gifted young chef, dreams big but faces a formidable obstacle, her ruthless employer Aishwarya. Unknown to both, Aishwarya is also Mannat's birth mother who abandoned her when she was born
programme.desc: एक प्रतिभाशाली युवा शेफ मन्नत, बड़े सपने देखती है लेकिन उसकी नियोक्ता ऐश्वर्या के रूप में उसके सामने बड़ी बाधा आती है। दोनों अंजान है, कि ऐश्वर्या मन्नत की माँ भी है जिसने उसे जन्म के समय छोड़ा था।.

credits.actor: Ayesha Singh (Mannat Khanna),Adnan Khan (Vikrant 'Aman' Saluja),Mamta Verma (Shruti Khanna),Mona Vasu (Sonia Khanna / Aishwarya Raisingh),Sharain Khanduja (Mallika 'Malla' Raisingh),Hasan Zaidi (Gagan Raisingh),Roopa Divetia (Keerat Raisingh),Pradeep Shukla (Rajendra Raisingh)

programme.title: डॉक्टर आरंभी
programme.sub-title: Vishwas is furious when Dhruv's legal letter grants Aarambhi custody of Vihaan, and she takes him away. Meanwhile, Aarambhi helps Manmeet fight back against their shared history of abuse
programme.desc: विवाह के बंधन में बंधी, पूर्व एआईपीएमटी टॉपर आरंभी एक छिपे हुए सपने को संजोए रखती है, अपने जीवन के दूसरे अध्याय को शुरू करने के लिए एक चिंगारी का इंतजार करती है।.

credits.actor: Aishwarya Khare,Aditya Bipin Redij,Arjit Taneja (Dhruv Chawla),Anjum Fakih (Dr. Avantika Mehta),Neena Cheema (Kunika Chawla),Bhuvnesh Shetty (Balbir Chaudhary)

programme.title: सहर होने को है
programme.sub-title: As Mahid's anxiety peaks, he is haunted by a vision of Seher soaked in blood. Later, he turns to Fareed for advice and decides it is best to leave her
programme.desc: सहर बड़े सपने देखने वाली एक युवा महिला है, और उसकी मां कौसर अपनी बेटी के रास्ते में आने वाली सामाजिक बाधाओं को दूर करने के लिए दृढ़ संकल्पित है।.

credits.actor: Parth Samthaan (Mahid),Rishita Kothari (Seher),Mahhi Vij (Kausar),Vaquar Shaikh,Apurva Agnihotri,Deepak Qazir

programme.title: बरेली के बच्चन
programme.sub-title: Krishna fails to see the sunrise after staying awake all night. Meanwhile, Satluj saves Raghuvendra from danger, though her intervention soon sparks a clash
programme.desc: महत्वाकांक्षी संगम को कई चुनौतियों का सामना करना पड़ता है जब वह बेफिक्र कृष्णा बच्चन से शादी करती है और ऐसे पुरुषों के घर में आती है जो किसी महिला के साथ रहने के आदी नहीं हैं।.

credits.actor: Pravisht Mishra (Krishna Bacchan),Ramneek Kataria (Sangam Yadav),Yashpal Sharma (Ajab Singh),Kinshuk Mahajan (Ganga)

programme.title: शायद यही है प्यार
programme.sub-title: Shanti contacts Preeti and inquires why she deceived her about taking a train to Dehradun when Manju witnessed her departing in a car with a man
programme.desc: After leaving a toxic relationship, 35-year-old Preeti gets a second chance at love when 25-year-old Aarav enters her life. As their bond grows, they navigate societal taboos due to their age gap.

credits.actor: Aditi Dev Sharma (Preeti Arora),Daksh Puri (Aarav),Kunal Karan Kapoor (Gagan),Jagat Rawat (Vinod),Nidhi Tiwari (Manju),Namami Vashishth (Tina),Sarthak Sharma (Monty)

programme.title: महादेव एण्ड संस
programme.sub-title: Some goons infiltrate Mahadev's rice mill and disrupt the stock, causing Rajji to inform Mahadev and his family about Bhanu's plan to burn the establishment, which disturbs everyone
programme.desc: महादेव का सिद्धांतवादी दृष्टिकोण अपने परिवार को मजबूत हाथों से मार्गदर्शन करने का अनजाने में विद्रोह के बीज बोता है, जो पीढ़ीगत असंतोष के युग की शुरुआत करता है।.

credits.actor: Shakti Anand,Sneha Wagh,Manasi Salvi,Deepak Khati,Mohit Joshi,Aasim Khan,Garvita Sadhwani,Neha Rana

programme.title: बिग बॉस
programme.sub-title: The conflict between Arishfa and Lovepreet intensifies as Scout probes Yung's silence
programme.desc: एक प्रतियोगिता में अजनबियों का समूह, पुरस्कार जीतने के लिए एक घ्जर में सख्त नियमों का पालन और कठिन चुनौतियों का सामना करते हुए साथ रहता है।.

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: లూనీ ట్యూన్స్ కార్టూన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: బగ్స్ బన్నీ, డాఫీ డక్, పోర్కీ పిగ్, ట్వీటీ, రోడ్ రన్నర్, ఇతర పాత్రలు వరుస హాస్యాస్పదమైన సాహసాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.sub-title: The real hard work for a physically powerful predator is in working out a strategy for attack

programme.desc: Driven by rising global temperatures, numerous wildlife species employ remarkable strategies for survival.

programme.desc: Reveals the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. We examine how massive seasonal events affect the lives of individual animals as their stories develop across the year.

programme.title: Wild Fighters
programme.sub-title: The most elemental and pure survival is based on eating. If you are not healthy, strong and agile, you cannot compete to mate, you cannot defend your family from any threat, nor will you be able to achieve good status in your clan
programme.desc: Explores the fights for the survival of various wild creatures and their motivations to win.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.sub-title: Kamuti is a wise old leopard who has reigned over two square miles of prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for ten years, but now she is in trouble. At 13 years old, Kamuti is one of the oldest leopards in the African bush, and she is not as effective a hunter as she used to be. Kamuti's problems are compounded by her neighbours, the Nsefu pride of lions, who steal her kills and attack her on sight
programme.desc: An intimate insight into the lives of the prominent wild predators of Africa as they face their daily struggles.

programme.title: The Loneliness of the Leopard
programme.desc: Exploring the lives of solitary leopards, their habitat, behaviour, and challenges in the wild.

programme.title: Air Jaws: The Hunt for Colossus
programme.desc: A 20-foot great white breaches in New Zealand, sparking a hunt for Colossus, the flying shark who went missing 10 years ago from South Africa's waters; could he still be alive and lead researchers to a secret colony of lost great whites?

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.sub-title: Under the ocean, its survival of the fittest... and fastest. Stonefish vacuum food in, seals whiplash their victims to death and Mantis Shrimps unleash hammer blows with the acceleration of bullets. With over three billion years to get inventive, ocean creatures have exploded the design envelope wide open in their quest for speed!
programme.desc: The fastest predators in the animal kingdom are exposed in detail.

programme.title: Wild Battleground
programme.sub-title: There is an icy heat of aggression in some of the coldest habitats on Earth, as life-threatening environmental conditions bring out predators' competitive sides
programme.desc: Different animals use the terrain and their unique attributes to their advantage and defeat their opponents at each location, becoming masters of communication, camouflage, diplomacy, and combat.

programme.title: A Wolf's Choice - Family or Freedom?

programme.desc: Jeremy Wade is not a fisherman; he's an `extreme angler' in search of the biggest and most dangerous freshwater fish, the kind with a taste for human flesh. This action-adventure series also features Wade illustrating how these river monsters are constructed to kill.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल 2026
programme.sub-title: An anthology of true-crime stories that explore how the digital age, meant to advance the human race, facilitates dark, violent crimes
programme.desc: सच्ची आपराधिक घटनाओं की कहानियों का एक संग्रह, जो यह उजागर करता है, कि कैसे डिजिटल युग, जिसका उद्देश्य मानव जाति को आगे बढ़ाना था, काले और हिंसक अपराधों को बढ़ावा देता है।.

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल 2026
programme.sub-title: A missing bride and a trail of deception push the murder conspiracy to its conclusion. Later, unexpected revelations finally expose the truth behind Vikas's death
programme.desc: सच्ची आपराधिक घटनाओं की कहानियों का एक संग्रह, जो यह उजागर करता है, कि कैसे डिजिटल युग, जिसका उद्देश्य मानव जाति को आगे बढ़ाना था, काले और हिंसक अपराधों को बढ़ावा देता है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: क्राइम पैट्रोल
programme.sub-title: The host presents dramatised re-enactments of real-life crime cases that revolve around harassment, kidnapping and murder
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, उत्पीड़न, अपहरण और हत्या पर आधारित वास्तविक जीवन के आपराधिक मामलों का नाटकीय रूपांतरण प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: A compilation of the best cases investigated in 'Crime Patrol' showcases people from different walks of life falling victim to the vices of others or their own
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल: 48 घंटे
programme.sub-title: In Madhya Pradesh, the police find a two-year-old dead body at a construction site. As the investigation begins, the police realize that this is the work of a serial killer as they uncover more dead bodies from the same site
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता अपराध के मामलों का नाटकीय रूप से मंचन करते हैं तथा पुलिस विभाग द्वारा 48 घंटों के भीतर मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए किए गए सतर्क प्रयासों को दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid: Global Showdown
programme.desc: International survivalists work in duos across 40 days of wilderness, living to honour their countries and claim a monetary reward.

credits.actor: Matt Wright,Gabrielle Balassone,Kylie Furneaux,Jeff Zausch,Dan Link,Kerra Bennett,Rachel Strohl,Teal Bulthuis,Marina Fukushima,Frank Eytcheson,Rene Murad,Michael Brown

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: Will the survivalists have the emotional strength and drive to endure grueling conditions and find out what they're made of? From hand crafting a bird 'nuggets' to ward off starvation, to skinning pelts with their bare hands, watch as each couple battles the elements, each other, and their own inner weaknesses to see who will triumph over the terrain, or fail under the force of nature
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, भारत के विभिन्न धार्मिक स्थलों की यात्रा करते हैं, उनके सांस्कृतिक महत्व पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और तीर्थयात्रियों के अनुभव साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: इंडिपीडिया

programme.title: परिक्रमा

programme.title: रेजिमेंट डायरीज़

programme.desc: एक प्रसिद्ध भारतीय शेफ कई तरह के स्वादिष्ट व्यंजनों की रेसिपी साझा करते हैं और स्टेप बाइ स्टेप उसे बनाकर दिखाते हैं।.

programme.title: राजा रसोई और अंदाज़ अनोखा

programme.title: एपिक एक्सप्लोरर
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the journey of numerous international explorers who landed on India's shores for trade, alliance and exploration
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता कई अंतरराष्ट्रीय खोजकर्ताओं की यात्रा के बारे में बताते हैं जो व्यापार, गठबंधन और अन्वेषण के लिए भारत के तटों पर उतरे थे।.

programme.title: डिस्ट्रक्शन डिकोडेड
programme.sub-title: An in-depth look at catastrophic events, analysing the science behind natural and man-made disasters and exploring the causes and consequences through expert insights and CGI visuals
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम में प्राकृतिक और मानव निर्मित आपदाओं के पीछे के विज्ञान का विश्लेषण और अंतर्दृष्टि और सीजीआई दृश्यों के माध्यम से उनके कारणों और परिणामों पर जानकारी दी जाती है।.

programme.title: वेषभूषा
programme.sub-title: Tracing the origins of traditional Indian attires, the host delves deeper into the historical significance of the indigenous clothing of the country
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता पारंपरिक भारतीय पोशाकों की उत्पत्ति का पता लगाते हुए देश के स्वदेशी कपड़ों के ऐतिहासिक महत्व पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

credits.director: Anup Acharya,Jaspreet Kaur Jain,Preety Pareek,Saurabh Srivastava

programme.title: उमीद इंडिया
programme.sub-title: Virender Sehwag travels to the training bases of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at the 2020 Olympics, meeting their coaching staff and families, who are there to ensure their success
programme.desc: वीरेंद्र सहवाग 2020 ओलंपिक में गौरव हासिल करने का लक्ष्य रखने वाले निडर एथलीटों के प्रशिक्षण केंद्रों में जाते हैं, कोचिंग स्टाफ और परिवारों से मिलते हैं, जो उनकी सफलता देखने वहां मौजूद होते हैं।.

programme.title: द ग्रेट एस्केप
programme.sub-title: Various artists re-enact the bravest escapes from captivity that prominent personalities have executed in the past in different parts of the world
programme.desc: विभिन्न कलाकार अतीत में विश्व के विभिन्न भागों में प्रमुख हस्तियों द्वारा कैद से बहादुरीपूर्वक भागने की घटनाओं का पुनः मंचन करते हैं।.

programme.title: अदृश्य
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of India's greatest spies, the dangers they faced as they executed their missions and how they risked their lives for national honour
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार, भारत के सबसे महान जासूसों के जीवन की खोज करते हैं, जिन्हें अपने मिशन को अंजाम देते वक्त खतरों का सामना करना पड़ा और राष्ट्रीय सम्मान के लिए अपने जीवन को जोखिम में डाला था।.

credits.actor: Sunny Hinduja (Ravindra Kaushik),Prashantt Guptha (Chand Bardai),Rajesh Khera (Jeevsiddhi),Nishant Singh (Shivaji),Annie Sekhon (Sanyukta),Taranjit Kaur (Durgavati Vohra),Mansi Multani (Azeez-un-Nisa)

programme.title: जीवन एक संघर्ष
programme.sub-title: Karan, a good-hearted thief, is compelled to work for a criminal mastermind. However, things take a turn when he reunites with his estranged family and tries to leave the underworld
programme.desc: करण एक नेकदिल चोर है और रतन नामक एक गैंगस्टर को परेशान करने से रोकने की कोशिश करता है। इसके बाद, उसका जीवन बदल जाता है, जब वह अपने बिछड़े परिवार से मिलता है और मधु से प्यार करने लगता है।.

credits.actor: Rakhee Gulzar (Sulakshana Devi Kumar),Anil Kapoor (Karan Kumar),Madhuri Dixit (Madhu Sen),Anupam Kher (Devraj Kamat),Paresh Rawal (Rattan Dholakia),Moon Moon Sen (Shivani),Pankaj Dheer (Mahesh Dholakia),Kanwaljit Singh (Arjun Kumar)

programme.title: मर्डर
programme.sub-title: Simran is a lonely housewife who bumps into Sunny, her lover from her past, and the two get into a torrid affair. But when her husband finds out, he plans to end the affair as quickly as it began
programme.desc: अकेली गृहिणी, सिमरन संजोगवश अपने पूर्व-प्रेमी, सनी से मिलती है और दोनों फिर से संबंध में शामिल हो जाते हैं। लेकिन जब उसके पति को पता चलता है, वह जल्द से जल्द इस मामले को खत्म करने की योजना बनाता है।.

credits.actor: Ashmit Patel (Sudhir Saigal),Mallika Sherawat (Simran Saigal),Emran Hashmi (Sunny),Kashmira Shah (Lounge Singer),Raj Zutshi (Inspector Rajvir SIngh)

programme.title: Dooriyan
programme.desc: Daniyal and Sana have huge differences in social classes and unable to maintain their relationship.

programme.title: भ्रष्टाचार
programme.sub-title: Journalist Bhavani intends to expose and bring to justice a corrupt politician who pretends to be a social worker. However, she soon finds herself trapped in a web of conspiracies
programme.desc: पत्रकार भवानी, एक सामाजिक कार्यकर्ता होने का दिखावा करने वाले एक भ्रष्ट राजनेता को बेनकाब करके उसे सजा दिलाना चाहती है। लेकिन वह खुद एक षड्यंत्र के जाल में फंस जाती है।.

programme.title: ग़ुलाम
programme.sub-title: Siddharth, a boxer, rebels against Raunak, a local gangster, when the latter kills his friend but Jai, Siddharth's brother, does not encourage his actions
programme.desc: सिद्धार्थ नामक मुक्केबाज स्थानीय गैंगस्टर रौनक के खिलाफ विद्रोह करता है, क्योंकि रौनक उसके दोस्त की हत्या कर देता है। सिद्धार्थ का भाई जय उसके कार्यों को बढ़ावा देता है।.

credits.actor: Aamir Khan,Rani Mukerji,Deepak Tijori,Sharat Saxena,Akshay Anand,Rajit Kapoor,Mita Vashist

programme.title: क्रिमिनल
programme.sub-title: A compassionate physician establishes a hospital for the underprivileged, earning widespread acclaim. However, his world crumbles when he faces accusations of murdering his wife
programme.desc: डॉ॰ अजय गरीबों के लिए अस्पताल बनाता है। वह मशहूर हो जाता है और श्वेता से शादी करता है। इससे इंस्पेक्टर, राम्या का दिल टूट जाता है। श्वेता की हत्या के बाद, अजय को गिरफ्तार किया जता है।.

credits.actor: Ramya Krishna,Nagarjuna Akkineni,Manisha Koirala,Nassar,Sarathbabu,Gulshan Grover,Johny Lever

programme.title: परम्परा
programme.sub-title: Pratap and Ranvir want to settle their family fight by risking their friendship in a dangerous duel. Eventually, they reunite and embrace each other as brothers for the first time
programme.desc: दो दोस्त, प्रताप और रणवीर को पता चलता है कि अपने परिवारों के बीच का पुराना हिसाब बराबर करना बाकी है। दुर्भाग्यवश यह सिर्फ तभी पूरा हो सकता है जब वे एक घातक द्वंद्वयुद्ध में एक-दूसरे का सामना करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Sunil Dutt,Vinod Khanna,Aamir Khan,Ashwini Bhave,Raveena Tandon,Neelam,Vikas Anand,Aloka Mukherjee

programme.title: दुश्मन
programme.sub-title: Sonia is raped and murdered by Gokul. To avenge her death, her twin sister, Naina, takes help from a retired Major Suraj Singh Rathod, a man with visual impairment, and plans to teach the murderer a lesson
programme.desc: गोकुल, सोनिया का बलात्कार कर उसकी हत्या कर देता है । सोनिया की जुडवा बहन न्याय और बदला लेने के लिए सेवानिवृत अंधे मेजर सूरज सिंह की मदद लेती है ।.

credits.actor: Kajol,Sanjay Dutt,Ashutosh Rana,Jas Arora,Tanvi Azmi,Pramod Moutho,Kunal Khemu,Pratima Kazmi

programme.title: बड़े दिलवाला
programme.sub-title: Ram's, a police officer's, greedy wife buys a lottery ticket in hopes of winning. However, things get complicated when Ram promises Piya, a waitress, to share the prize money if he wins the lottery
programme.desc: एक पुलिस अधिकारी, एक महिला वेटर को टिप के बदले लॉटरी जीतने पर आधा इनाम देने का वादा करता है, लेकिन जब वह इनाम जीतता है, उसकी पत्नी पूरे इनाम पर दावा करने का प्रयास करती है।.

credits.actor: Sunil Shetty (Ram Prasad),Priya Gill (Piya Verma),Paresh Rawal (Mannubhai Rajnikant Shroff),Archana Puran Singh (Manthara),Satish Kaushik (Iqbal Shaikh),Ranjeet,Raju Srivastava

programme.desc: एक अमीर आदमी अपनी सारी जायदाद दान कर देता है, लेकिन अपनी बहन के लिए दहेज न दे पाने के कारण एक ज़मींदार उसका अपमान करता है। फिर अपना सम्मान वापस पाने के लिए वह अपने परिवार के साथ गाँव छोड़कर चला जाता है।.

programme.title: लंका
programme.desc: A gangster chooses to not marry his mistress and keeps her captive. One of his most-trusted protegees decides to plot a plan and free her.

programme.title: ஷக்திமான்
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: தனது யோக சக்திகளை கண்டுபிடித்து தீய வில்லனிடமிருந்து உலகை பாதுகாக்கும் சூப்பர் ஹீரோவாக மாறும் இளம் கல்லூரி மாணவன்.

programme.title: லிட்டில் ஹக்கா

programme.desc: இந்த சிறுவர் கார்ட்டூனில், குட்டி ஹக்கா தனது மாயாஜால தொப்பியைக் கொண்டு இயற்கையின் எதிரிகளை எதிர்த்துப் போராடுகிறாள்.

programme.title: ஹெய்டி

programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: బూనీ బేర్స్: ది అడ్వెంచరర్స్
programme.sub-title: Briar and Bramble, two bear siblings who love their forest home, keep thwarting the nefarious logger Vick's attempts to log timber from their forest
programme.desc: ఎలుగుబంట్లు బ్రియార్, బ్రాంబుల్ తమ అడవి నుండి కలపను లాగడానికి దుర్మార్గపు విక్ చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలను విఫలం చేస్తాయి.

credits.actor: Paul \"Maxx\" Rinehart,Rick Jay Glen,Justin J. Wheeler

programme.title: గ్లోరియా'స్ హౌస్
programme.sub-title: Gloria has a messy house, but it is more fun than any other house in Chillsville. Her daily life is full of adventures as she deals with her siblings and her neighbours
programme.desc: గందరగోళంగా ఉన్న ఇంట్లో తోబుట్టువులు, పొరుగువారితో వ్యవహరించే క్రమంలో గ్లోరియా దైనందిన జీవితం అనేక సాహసాలతో నిండిపోతుంది.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day

programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children

programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

programme.sub-title: King Indraverma receives suspicious reports about neighbouring kingdoms being annexed. Suddenly, raptor-like birds attack the palace and an injured woman in Grecian clothing is discovered

programme.title: छोटा भीम किरमाड़ा
programme.sub-title: Tabora and her wicked aunt hunt for the Agni Chakra to resurrect the vile Kirmada. Bheem and his companions must thwart their plans at all costs to protect their kingdom
programme.desc: ताबोरा और उसकी दुष्ट चाची दुष्ट किरमदा को पुनर्जीवित करने के लिए अग्नि चक्र की खोज में हैं। भीम और उसके साथियों को अपने राज्य की रक्षा के लिए हर कीमत पर उनकी योजनाओं को विफल करना होगा।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम: द क्यूरियस केस ऑफ स्वैप्ड सोल्स
programme.sub-title: To seize the kids' souls, Anira swaps Bheem and his friends' souls with one another. Limited in their powers while swapped, Bheem and his team must find the source of Anira's powers to undo the spell
programme.desc: बच्चों की आत्माओं को कब्ज़े में करने के लिए अनिरा भीम और उसके दोस्तों की आत्माओं की अदला-बदली करती है। आत्माएं बदलने के कारण शक्तियां सीमित होने पर, भीम और उसकी टीम को शक्तियों के स्रोत को खोजना होगा।.

programme.title: सिंघमवर्स वर्सेस कालवर्स 2
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and Veer Singham battle Reth Kaal to save Satrangi, a kingdom's soul bird. Moreover, they then pursue her through a mysterious multiverse
programme.desc: Explore the adventures of a nine-year-old boy who battles various challenges and evil villains that create chaos in the city.

programme.title: सिंघमवर्स वर्सेस कालवर्स 2
programme.sub-title: After failing to stop Reth Kaal, the Singhams follow Satrangi to the ocean multiverse where they meet Pirate Singham and help him search for the Sindu Mani

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: ओमी नंबर 1

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

programme.title: स्मैशिंग सिम्बा
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्णा मेलडिज
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: नन्हे कृष्ण वृंदावन में अपने दोस्तों के साथ तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए मज़े करते हैं। लेकिन जब दुष्ट कंस उनके जीवन में खलल डालने के लिए अपने अनुचर भेजता है, तब वे तुरंत हरकत में आ जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.sub-title: When a formidable monster tries to take over Mirchi Nagar with his demon army, Little Singham must confront him to save the city and its people

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, दक्षिण अफ्रीका के सुंदर परिदृश्य, विविध वन्य जीवन और समृद्ध संस्कृति का पता लगाने के लिए 10 दिवसीय यात्रा पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: एक्स्प्लोर श्रीलंका
programme.sub-title: With the archaeological and religious significance held by the two cities of Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa, the host unearths the historical and cultural glory of Sri Lanka
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता यूनेस्को की आठ विश्व धरोहर स्थलों सहित श्रीलंका के कुछ प्रमुख स्थानों का दौरा करते हैं और देश की जीवंत जीवनशैली को प्रकाश में लाते हैं।.

programme.title: सिटी ब्रेक्स
programme.sub-title: The host travels through Prague exploring the culture rich city with its picturesque castles, Czech beers and enchanting Segway rides
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, दुनिया के बेहतरीन शहरों की यात्रा करते हैं और वहां की विभिन्न संस्कृतियों, स्थानीय व्यंजनों और उन शहरों का इतिहास पता करते हैं।.

programme.title: फूड फ़ैक्ट फ़न
programme.sub-title: In Ho Chi Minh, Rohan tries local delicacies like Tom Ray fish and lotus seed, and explores sights like the Cu chi tunnels and Reunification Palace
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता दुनिया भर के विभिन्न स्थानों की यात्रा करते हैं और वहां के सर्वोत्तम भोजन, संस्कृति, मनोरंजक गतिविधियों आदि का आनंद उठाते हैं।.

programme.title: बैकपैक
programme.sub-title: Sabrina Chakici visits Sheki to gain insight into the art form of Shabaka, experience the crude oil spa treatment and explore Khinalug Village
programme.desc: एक अकेला यात्री, दुनिया भर के आकर्षक स्थलों की यात्रा करता है तथा कुछ प्रमुख स्थलों और सांस्कृतिक विविधता का अन्वेषण करता है।.

programme.title: इंडोनेशियास रोमांटिक गेटअवे
programme.sub-title: Two actors travel to Labuan Bajo, a popular fishing town lined with pristine beaches and coral reefs in order to go on exciting boat rides
programme.desc: The host explores the diverse beauty, heritage and culture of Indonesia and highlights its markets, historical and heritage spots and natural beauty.

programme.title: ब्लिस
programme.sub-title: The host explores the beautiful beaches, rich history, vast landscapes, distinctive architecture and delectable food of Santorini, an island located in the Aegean Sea
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, दुनिया भर के लुभावने दृश्यों और शांत वातावरण वाले नए और रोमांचक स्थानों की पड़ताल करने निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: बेस्ट फ्रॉम द रेस्ट
programme.sub-title: Tranquillity, scenic nature and harmony are the three attributes of sparkling and serene lakes. The host explores five of the most beautiful and shimmering lakes and salty seascapes
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, विश्व भर के कुछ सर्वाधिक लोकप्रिय स्थलों की यात्रा करते हैं और वहाँ की संस्कृति एवं परंपराओं के बारे में जानकारी हासिल करते हैं।.

programme.title: हेरिटेज
programme.sub-title: The presenter sheds light on Bryggen, a historic harbour district in Bergen, one of North Europe's oldest port cities on Norway's west coast
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, दुनिया भर के प्राचीन शहरों, विश्व धरोहर स्थलों, ऐतिहासिक स्मारकों और मंदिरों का प्रदर्शन करते हैं, जो वर्षों पुरानी संस्कृति का महत्व उजागर करते हैं।.

programme.title: लैंडमार्क्स
programme.sub-title: The host offers deeper insights into the architecture and history of the Old Town Clock, a noteworthy structure located in Canada's Nova Scotia
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता दुनिया भर के लोकप्रिय और दूरदराज के इलाकों की यात्रा करते हैं और साथ ही उन प्रसिद्ध और यादगार स्थलों की खोज करते हैं, जहाँ लोग अक्सर आते हैं।.

programme.title: वर्ल्ड स्पाज
programme.sub-title: Kerala has a lot to offer its visitors along with its exotic beaches, tropical backwaters and rejuvenation therapies of Ayurveda
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, चिकित्सकीय उपचार के विभिन्न प्रकार का अनुभव करने के लिए विश्व भर के स्पा का दौरा करते हैं, जो मन और शरीर का कायाकल्प कर सकते हैं।.

programme.title: फूड फ़ैक्ट फ़न
programme.sub-title: The host travels to various destinations around the world exploring some of their best food, culture, fun activities and more
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता दुनिया भर के विभिन्न स्थानों की यात्रा करते हैं और वहां के सर्वोत्तम भोजन, संस्कृति, मनोरंजक गतिविधियों आदि का आनंद उठाते हैं।.

programme.title: इंडोनेशियास रोमांटिक गेटअवे
programme.sub-title: Located in Central Java, Borobudur is one of the greatest Buddhist monuments in the world, offering a serene atmosphere of peace and quite to the arriving visitors
programme.desc: The host explores the diverse beauty, heritage and culture of Indonesia and highlights its markets, historical and heritage spots and natural beauty.

programme.title: 10 डेज कोरिया
programme.sub-title: Andrew learns about Seoul's modern culture, visits local markets, palaces, a museum and ends his trip with a visit to Korean War memorial

programme.title: एक्सप्लोर फ़िलिपिन्स
programme.sub-title: Manila gets its name from 'may nilad' referring to the flower that once grew abundantly here. The city has modern-day skyscrapers but has also managed to retain its rich Spanish influence

programme.sub-title: A conservationist journeys through the rivers of Africa to study the behaviour of the Tigerfish, a ferocious fish species with an aggressive nature and sharp teeth
programme.desc: संरक्षणवादी टाइगरफिश के व्यवहार का अध्ययन करने के लिए अफ्रीका की नदियों के माध्यम से यात्रा करते हैं, जो एक क्रूर मछली प्रजाति है, जिसका स्वभाव आक्रामक और तीखे दाँतों वाला होता है।.

programme.title: इन्वेशन ऑफ द मेगा शार्कस
programme.desc: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white believed to be one of the largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.

programme.title: लव वाइल्ड
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the various aspects of animal relationships, from competitive mating and fierce battles for mates to cooperative friendships and familial bonds
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता जानवरों के रिश्तों के अलग-अलग पहलुओं पर जानकारी देते हैं, जिसमें कॉम्पिटिटिव मेटिंग और साथी के लिए ज़ोरदार लड़ाई से लेकर मिलकर दोस्ती और परिवार के रिश्ते तक शामिल हैं।.

programme.title: द लाइयन्स रूल
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the daily activities of animals living in the hot climate of Glade, where the arrival of buffaloes to drink water turns into a feast for predators
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार राजसी अफ्रीकी शेरों से प्रेरित होकर जीवित रहने की एक शक्तिशाली कहानी को दर्शाते हैं, जिसमें वे भोजन की तलाश करते हैं और अपने क्षेत्र की सुरक्षा के लिए एकजुट होते हैं।.

programme.title: द सवाना: वाइल्ड हैप्पिनेस
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.title: डेड्लीएस्ट साउथ अफ्रीका
programme.sub-title: Kurdt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate people to see the value of these often-misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: कर्ड्ट ग्रीनवुड दक्षिण अफ्रीका के बारह सबसे घातक साँपों की खोज में लगे हैं, साथ ही वे लोगों को इन अक्सर गलत समझे जाने वाले जीवों के मूल्य को समझने के लिए शिक्षित और प्रेरित भी कर रहे हैं।.

programme.title: टाइगरफिश: अफ्रीकास पिरान्हा
programme.sub-title: A conservationist journeys through the rivers of Africa to study the behaviour of the Tigerfish, a ferocious fish species with an aggressive nature and sharp teeth

programme.title: सरवाइव द वाइल्ड
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on different techniques used by animals to hunt and survive in the wild through archival footage and graphics
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पुराने फुटेज और ग्राफिक्स के माध्यम से जंगल में शिकार करने और जीवित रहने के लिए जानवरों द्वारा इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली विभिन्न तकनीकों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: नेचर्स ग्रेटेस्ट सर्वाइवर्स
programme.sub-title: Diverse creatures strive for essential sustenance across polar ice caps, deserts and deep seas. Consequently, swift agility aids endurance
programme.desc: The exploration of how massive natural forces shape remarkable life in the wild. Furthermore, the journey showcases distinct species.

programme.title: अफ्रीकाज़ सीक्रेट क्रिएचर्स
programme.sub-title: Diverse animal species display unique resilience and behaviour, facing numerous challenges as they adapt and struggle to survive in the wild
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता क्रूगर नेशनल पार्क में जीवित रहने की चुनौतियों का सामना करने वाले सात हैरान करने वाले जानवरों की छिपी गतिविधियों का पता लगाते हैं।.

programme.title: फोर्स ऑफ नेचर
programme.desc: Reveals the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. We examine how massive seasonal events affect the lives of individual animals as their stories develop across the year.

programme.title: वाइल्ड फाइटर्स
programme.sub-title: Life in the wild is tumultuous and transient as the host explores the hidden and deeply instinctual motives driving animals to fight for survival
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता जंगली जानवरों द्वारा अनुभव किए जाने वाले अस्तित्व के संघर्ष के पीछे छिपे और गहरे सहज उद्देश्यों की खोज करते हैं।.

programme.title: अफ्रीकास हन्टर्स
programme.sub-title: Kamuti, a senior female leopard ruling a prime Luangwa Valley territory for decades, now faces challenges threatening her reign
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार, प्रमुख अफ्रीकी शिकारियों के व्यवहार और भौतिक विशेषताओं को उजागर करते है। वह उनके शिकार करने और खुद की रक्षा के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली रणनीतियाँ भी बताते है।.

programme.title: द लोनलिलेस ऑफ द लेपर्ड
programme.sub-title: The presenter shares the captivating story of solitary leopards, exploring their habitat, behavior and challenges in the wild
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता अकेले रहने वाले तेंदुओं की दिलचस्प कहानी साझा करते हैं और जंगल में उनके रहने की जगह, व्यवहार और चुनौतियों के बारे में बताते हैं।.

programme.title: एयर जॉज: द हंट फॉर कोलोसस
programme.sub-title: The breach of a massive great white in New Zealand triggers an expedition to find Colossus, a mythical shark thought to reveal a secret great white colony
programme.desc: न्यूज़ीलैंड में एक विशाल ग्रेट व्हाइट शार्क के छूटने से एक काल्पनिक शार्क कोलोसस को ढूंढने का अभियान शुरू होता है, जिसके बारे में माना जाता है कि यह एक गुप्त ग्रेट व्हाइट कॉलोनी का खुलासा कर सकती है।.

programme.title: स्पीड किल्स
programme.sub-title: Stonefishes strike at unbelievable speeds and mantis shrimps throw the fastest punches in the animal kingdom, as they showcase alarming speed in the churning and seemingly slow-moving ocean
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता पशु साम्राज्य के सबसे तेज़ और सबसे क्रूर शिकारियों की शिकार शैलियों को समझने के लिए वर्षावनों, सवाना और जल निकायों की खोज करते हैं।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड बैटलग्राउंड
programme.desc: The filmmaker provides insights into some of the unique characteristics of various predatory animals while focusing on their survival instincts.

programme.title: अ वुल्फ़्स चॉइस - फैमिली ऑर फ्रीडम?
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides detailed insights on the behaviours of wolves and how they become a pack or seek their own path as a lone wolf
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार भेड़ियों के व्यवहार और वे कैसे एक झुंड बन जाते हैं या अकेले भेड़िये के रूप में अपना रास्ता तलाशते हैं, इस पर विस्तृत जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: सन्स ऑफ एंकैई
programme.sub-title: An intimate look at the relationship between man and nature in one of the most iconic wild places on Earth: the Masai Mara, Kenya
programme.desc: पृथ्वी पर सबसे प्रतिष्ठित जंगली स्थानों में से एक: मसाई मारा, केन्या में मनुष्य और प्रकृति के बीच संबंधों पर एक नज़र।.

programme.title: रिवर मॉन्स्टर्स
programme.sub-title: The host, a biologist who is an extreme angler, explores freshwater mysteries and local folklore, to debunk fascinating myths and track down harrowing tales
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता जो एक जीवविज्ञानी और मछुआरा हैं, वे कई मिथकों को खत्म करने और उनसे जुड़ी खौफ़नाक कहानियों को जानने के लिए मीठे पानी के रहस्यों और स्थानीय लोककथाओं की पड़ताल करते हैं।.

programme.title: Lake Life: Secrets Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Dive beneath the surface to explore rare species, geological wonders and unique ecosystems in Germany's and Austria's most stunning lakes.

programme.title: गोल्डन ईगल: कॉल ऑफ़ द वाइल्ड
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: मसाई मारा:अफ्रीकी वाइल्डलाइफ स्टोरीज़
programme.sub-title: The wildlife of the Maasai Mara reveals the raw beauty and realities of one of the most untamed lands, highlighting the daily struggle for survival and the balance between predator and prey
programme.desc: मासाई मारा का वन्यजीवन सबसे अदम्य भूमि में से एक की प्राकृतिक सुंदरता और वास्तविकताओं को प्रकट करता है, जो जीवन के संघर्ष और शिकारी और शिकार के बीच संतुलन को उजागर करता है।.

programme.title: मेडिटेरेनियन हंटर्स
programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: अफ्रीकास हन्टर्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the behaviour and physical features of major African predators and the strategies that they use to kill their prey and defend themselves
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार, प्रमुख अफ्रीकी शिकारियों के व्यवहार और भौतिक विशेषताओं को उजागर करते है। वह उनके शिकार करने और खुद की रक्षा के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली रणनीतियाँ भी बताते है।.

programme.title: लाइअनिस इन एग्ज़ाइल
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker traces the journey of a lioness, striving to overcome the challenges of the wildlife ecosystem, along with protecting her cubs from danger
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार एक शेरनी की यात्रा का वर्णन करते हैं, जो अपने शावकों को खतरे से बचाने के साथ-साथ वन्यजीव पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र की चुनौतियों पर काबू पाने का प्रयास करती है।.

programme.title: द लाइयन्स रूल
programme.sub-title: A nasty cub attempts to mate with members of the pride, for which it is asked to leave the group by an authoritative adult through the use of violence
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार राजसी अफ्रीकी शेरों से प्रेरित होकर जीवित रहने की एक शक्तिशाली कहानी को दर्शाते हैं, जिसमें वे भोजन की तलाश करते हैं और अपने क्षेत्र की सुरक्षा के लिए एकजुट होते हैं।.

programme.title: प्राइड रूल्स
programme.sub-title: Wildlife experts offer detailed insights into the social hierarchies existing within a pride of lions at the Serengeti National Park, in northern Tanzania
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता शेरों के जीवन, उनके जीवित रहने की प्रवृत्ति और अन्य जानवरों से खुद की रक्षा करने की उनकी आदत के बारे में जानते हैं।.

programme.title: Wild Spain - A tale of two brothers
programme.desc: The connection of two brothers and wildlife filmmakers with Spanish nature, through spectacular images of the social life of dolphins, whales, or jellyfish in the Mediterranean Sea. Sergi and Jordi Escandell manage to tell a different story.

programme.title: अमेजिंग अफ्रीका
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the varied wildlife found in different regions of Africa, which is home to diverse types of habitat and the tribes who refuse to change their lifestyle

programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: Will the survivalists have the emotional strength and drive to endure grueling conditions and find out what they're made of? From hand crafting a bird 'nuggets' to ward off starvation, to skinning pelts with their bare hands, watch as each couple battles the elements, each other, and their own inner weaknesses to see who will triumph over the terrain, or fail under the force of nature
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता महिलाओं को आत्मनिर्भर बनाने के लिए उपलब्ध स्वच्छता, ऋण स्वीकृति नीतियों और विद्युतीकरण से संबंधित विभिन्न योजनाओं के बारे में बताते हैं।.

programme.title: किसान यात्रा
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the latest updates and significant developments concerning the agriculture sector of the country
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता देश के कृषि क्षेत्र से संबंधित नवीनतम अपडेट और महत्वपूर्ण विकास के बारे में विस्तार से बताते हैं।.

programme.title: दी एग्रो फैक्ट्री
programme.sub-title: Subject-matter experts in the field of farming and agriculture shed light on the various ways they optimise their agricultural produce
programme.desc: खेती और कृषि के क्षेत्र के विशेषज्ञ अपने कृषि उत्पादन को अनुकूलित करने के विभिन्न तरीकों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: कृषि विशेष
programme.sub-title: The host discusses the latest and the most relevant updates from the field of agriculture and analyses them to shed more light on them
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, कृषि क्षेत्र के नवीनतम और प्रासंगिक जानकारी पर चर्चा करते हैं और उन पर अधिक प्रकाश डालने के लिए उनका विश्लेषण करते हैं।.

programme.title: कृषि शिक्षा और अनुसंधान
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest updates from the agriculture sector and provides details of the farming technologies being developed and implemented in the country
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता कृषि क्षेत्र से जुड़े नवीनतम जानकारी पेश करते हैं और देश में विकसित और कार्यान्वित की जा रही कृषि प्रौद्योगिकियों का विवरण प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: मंडी खबर
programme.sub-title: The host provides an update on the latest agriculture-related news and discusses the rates of various commodities in different markets
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता कृषि से संबंधित नवीनतम समाचारों पर जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं तथा विभिन्न बाजारों में विभिन्न वस्तुओं की दरों पर चर्चा करते हैं।.

programme.title: किसान समाचार
programme.sub-title: The host gives insights into the latest agricultural technology, innovations and facilities, and the methods to cultivate a good produce
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता नवीनतम कृषि तकनीक, नवाचारों और सुविधाओं, और अच्छी उपज उगाने के तरीकों के बारे में जानकारी देते हैं।.

programme.title: सच का साथ
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the latest and recent developments of the country and discusses and analyses the topics with experts
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता देश के नवीनतम और ताजा घटनाक्रमों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं तथा विशेषज्ञों के साथ विषयों पर चर्चा और विश्लेषण करते हैं।.

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता देश भर के कृषि से जुड़े महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और साथ ही किसानों के लिए मददगार महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी भी प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: स्वामी हरि चैतन्य महाप्रभु जी
programme.sub-title: Swami Hari Chaitanya ji delivers a discourse on various religious aspects to a gathering of devotees, inspiring them to follow the principles of spirituality
programme.desc: स्वामी हरि चैतन्य जी भक्तों के एक समूह को विभिन्न धार्मिक पहलुओं पर प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा उन्हें आध्यात्मिकता के सिद्धांतों का पालन करने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।.

programme.title: इस्कॉन
programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees perform rituals and chant sacred verses in praise of Lord Krishna at the ISKCON Temple in India
programme.desc: भारत में इस्कॉन मंदिर में हिंदू पुजारी और भक्त भगवान कृष्ण की स्तुति में अनुष्ठान करते हैं और पवित्र श्लोकों का जाप करते हैं।.

programme.title: मिनरल गुरु
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: संत रामपाल जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Sant Rampal Ji Maharaj delivers a discourse based on sacred religious scriptures and imparts their significance among the followers
programme.desc: संत रामपाल जी महाराज पवित्र धार्मिक ग्रंथों पर आधारित प्रवचन देते हैं और अनुयायियों के बीच उनका महत्व बताते हैं।.

programme.title: जीसस कॉल
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders representing the church lead a session of prayer, after which devotees share their holistic experiences and the miracles they have witnessed
programme.desc: चर्च का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले धार्मिक गुरु एक प्रार्थना सत्र का नेतृत्व करते हैं, जिसके बाद अनुयायी अपने समग्र अनुभव और अपने द्वारा देखे गए चमत्कारों को साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: राम नारायण राम
programme.sub-title: The host engages in illuminating dialogues with spiritual leaders, gaining vital knowledge about various religious concepts
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता आध्यात्मिक गुरुओं के साथ ज्ञानवर्धक संवाद में संलग्न होते हैं, तथा विभिन्न धार्मिक अवधारणाओं के बारे में महत्वपूर्ण ज्ञान प्राप्त करते हैं।.

programme.title: भविष्य दर्पण
programme.sub-title: An astrologer reads the position of celestial objects and provides comprehensive predictions of the future for 12 zodiac signs
programme.desc: एक ज्योतिषी आकाशीय पिंडों की स्थिति को पढ़ते हैं और बारह राशियों के भविष्य के बारे में विस्तार से भविष्यवाणी करते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: A petty thief vows to seek vengeance from a lawyer after the latter is involved in his brother's murder. Eventually, he abducts the lawyer's son and trains him in burglary as an act of revenge
programme.desc: தனது சகோதரனின் கொலையில் ஈடுபட்ட வழக்கறிஞரை பழிவாங்க அவரின் மகனை கடத்தி அவனுக்கு கொள்ளையடிக்க பயிற்சியளிக்கும் திருடன்.

programme.title: ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது.

programme.title: பொய்க்கால் குதிரை
programme.sub-title: Kathiravan loses his wife and his leg in an accident and decides to get a prosthetic leg with the compensation money. His life is complicated further when his daughter is hospitalised
programme.desc: கதிரவன் ஒரு விபத்தில் தனது மனைவியையும் காலையும் இழக்கிறார், இழப்பீட்டுத் தொகையில் செயற்கைக் கால் பெற முடிவு செய்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Prabhu Deva,Prakash Raj,Varalaxmi Sarathkumar,Raiza Wilson,Baby Aazhiya,John Kokken,Samuthirakani,Bharath Raj,Jagan,Prema Priya,Chandrasekar Koneru

programme.title: ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television

programme.title: பணக்கார குடும்பம்
programme.sub-title: Despite being his daughter, Rani is not allowed to acknowledge Muthiah as her father. She works in his office and falls in love with a co-worker, but Muthiah opposes their relationship
programme.desc: ராணி அலுவலகத்தில் வேலை செய்கிறாள், அங்கே ஒரு சக ஊழியரை காதலிக்கிறாள், ஆனால் முத்தையா அவர்களின் உறவை எதிர்க்கிறான்.

credits.actor: M. G. Ramachandran,B. Saroja Devi,Nagesh,Manimala,S. A. Ashokan,R.S. Manohar,A. K. Veerasami,Karikol Raju

programme.title: டாடா பிர்லா
programme.sub-title: Priya's parents die in her childhood and their will claims that the wealth will go to an orphanage when Priya dies. Learning this, her uncle conspires to capture her wealth and kill her
programme.desc: பிரியாவின் பெற்றோர்கள் அவளுடைய குழந்தை பருவத்தில் இறந்த பின், மாமா அவளுடைய செல்வங்களை கைப்பற்ற கொல்ல சதி செய்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Parthiban (Raja),Rachana Banerjee (Priya),Goundamani (Ranjith),Manivannan (Ramanathan),Sachu,Venniradai Moorthy,Nellai Siva (Police head constable)

programme.sub-title: A curated a collection of harmonious devotional hymns dedicated to Lord Venkateswara, praising the divine avatar of Vishnu
programme.desc: విష్ణుమూర్తి దివ్య అవతారాన్ని స్తుతిస్తూ, వెంకటేశ్వరుడికి అంకితం చేయబడిన శ్రావ్యమైన భక్తి స్తోత్రాల సమాహారం.

programme.title: ద్వారకా తిరుమల సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: Devotional hymns and prayers dedicated to Lord Venkateswara are beautifully presented, creating a peaceful atmosphere for worshippers and helping them connect with their faith
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ సంగీతకారులు స్వరపరచిన, ప్రముఖ గాయకులు ఆలపించిన శ్రీ వేంకటేశ్వర స్వామి భక్తి గీతాల సమగ్ర సంకలనం.

programme.title: వందేమాతరం సాంగ్
programme.sub-title: A compilation of patriotic songs glorifying the greatness and unity of India and performed by various artists is played back to back
programme.desc: భారతదేశ గొప్పతనాన్ని మరియు ఐక్యతను కీర్తిస్తూ వివిధ కళాకారులు ప్రదర్శించే దేశభక్తి గీతాల త్వరితగతిన ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: నాదస్వరం
programme.sub-title: Professional musicians play classical compositions on the nadaswaram, a traditional South Indian wind instrument, and enthrall the viewers
programme.desc: ప్రొఫెషనల్ సంగీతకారులు ప్రేక్షకులను అలరించడానికి నాదస్వరం అనే పవన వాయిద్యంలో శాస్త్రీయ సంగీతాన్ని వాయిస్తారు.

programme.title: డివోషనల్ సాంగ్స్
programme.sub-title: A religious leader and devotees sing songs to praise the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, భక్తులు భగవంతుని బోధనలను స్తుతించడానికి పాటలు పాడతారు, ఆధ్యాత్మికత మార్గాన్ని తీసుకోమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: అర్చన
programme.sub-title: Religious priests and devotees offer prayers and perform sacred rituals to seek the blessings of the Almighty at a place of worship
programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒక పుణ్యక్షేత్రంలో భగవంతుడి కృపాకటాక్షలను కోరుతూ ఆచార వ్యవహారాలతో ప్రత్యేక పూజలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: డివోషనల్ సాంగ్స్
programme.sub-title: A religious leader and devotees sing songs to praise the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality

programme.title: పసిడిపంటలు
programme.sub-title: The host talks about the latest tools, methods and technology used in agriculture and shares helpful and insightful farming tips
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత, వ్యవసాయంలో ఉపయోగించే తాజా సాధనాలు, పద్ధతులు, సాంకేతికతల గురించి మాట్లాడుతుంది, వ్యవసాయ చిట్కాలు పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: ప్రవచనాలు
programme.sub-title: Different religious scholars provide insight on an array of topics concerning Hinduism, including how to seek God in daily life
programme.desc: పలువురు ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు హిందూమతానికి సంబంధించిన అంశాల గురించి వివరిస్తూ, దేవుడిని ఎలా ప్రార్థించాలో వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: వార్తలు
programme.sub-title: The host presents a comprehensive and detailed coverage, elucidating on the latest news and developments from across the region
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత స్థానిక ప్రాంతానికి చెందిన తాజా వార్తా విశేషాలు, పరిణామాల గురించి తెలుపుతూ, వివరణాత్మక విశ్లేషణ అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: తరానే పురానే
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most famous old Bollywood songs, composed by well-known artists and singers are played
programme.desc: ప్రసిద్ధ కళాకారులు, గాయకులు స్వరపరిచిన అత్యంత ప్రసిద్ధ పాత బాలీవుడ్ పాటల సమగ్ర సంకలనం ప్రసారం చేయబడుతుంది.

programme.title: ఆన్ ది లైన్
programme.sub-title: When the host of a radio show is threatened on air by a psychopath, he must abide by his rules and play his games to ensure the safety of his family
programme.desc: ఒక రేడియో కార్యక్రమ వ్యాఖ్యాతను ప్రసార సమయంలో ఒక మానసిక రోగి బెదిరించబడినప్పుడు, అతను తన నియమాలకు కట్టుబడి ఉండాలి.

credits.actor: Mel Gibson (Elvis Cooney),William Moseley (Dylan),Alia Seror-O'Neill (Mary),Paul Spera (Gary/James),Nadia Farès (Sam Dubois),Enrique Arce (Tony),Kevin Dillon (Justin),Yoli Fuller (Steven),Avant Strangel (Officer Glass)

programme.sub-title: Renowned sexologist Dr Kamaraj provides expert advice on issues like impotency and erectile dysfunction, while offering treatment recommendations tailored to individual needs
programme.desc: பாலியல் நிபுணர் டாக்டர் காமராஜ்,ஆண்மைக்குறைவு-விறைப்புத்தன்மை பிரச்சினைகளில் ஆலோசனைகளை வழங்கி, பரிந்துரைகளை அளிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: எங்கிருந்தோ வந்தாள்
programme.sub-title: A courtesan meets a wealthy man, who asks her to help his mentally ill son to heal by pretending to be his wife. Later, she faces abuse from the family members
programme.desc: மனநலம் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட ஒருவரை குணமாக்க மனைவியாக நடிக்கும் விலைமாது, பின்னர் அக்குடும்பத்தால் துஷ்பிரயோகத்தை சந்திக்கிறாள்.

programme.title: காதல் கண் கட்டுதே
programme.sub-title: Shiva and Athulya, a young couple, try to maintain their long-distance relationship. However, their bond is endangered when Athulya's colleague starts to fall for her
programme.desc: தங்களது நீண்ட தூர உறவை தொடர முயலும் இளம் ஜோடியான ஷிவா மற்றும் அதுல்யாவின் வாழ்வில் சிக்கலை ஏற்படுத்தும் அவளது சக ஊழியர்.

programme.title: அய்யா வழி சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Devotional artists and singers perform soulful hymns, celebrating Ayya Vaikundar, a 19th-century visionary and social reformer, inspiring faith and social change
programme.desc: பக்திப் பாடகர்கள் 19 ஆம் நூற்றாண்டின் தொலைநோக்கு பார்வையாளரான அய்யா வைகுண்டரைக் கொண்டாடி, பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders along with devotees recite morning prayers, conduct rituals and sing devotional songs in praise of various Hindu deities
programme.desc: மத தலைவர்கள் பக்தர்களுடன் காலை பிரார்த்தனைகளை ஓதி, சடங்குகளை நடத்தி, இந்து தெய்வங்களை போற்றி பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: இண்டியா சாங்க்
programme.sub-title: A group of experienced artists, musicians and singers perform a special patriotic song depicting the beauty, traditions and cultures of India
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் அழகு, மரபுகள் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரங்களை சித்தரிக்கும் ஒரு சிறப்பு தேசபக்தி பாடலை நிகழ்த்தும் பாடகர்கள் குழு.

programme.desc: ప్రెస్ మీట్‌లో జర్నలిస్టులు అడిగిన ప్రశ్నలకు 'డ్రింకర్ సాయి' సినిమా నటీనటులు, సిబ్బంది ఆన్‌సెట్ అనుభవాలను పంచుకున్నారు.

programme.sub-title: The actors and makers of 'Sankranthiki Vasthunam' film gather to officially launch the trailer of the film and share their experiences of working on the project
programme.desc: 'సంక్రాంతికి వస్తున్నాం' చిత్ర నటీనటులు, దర్శకుడు సినిమా ట్రైలర్‌ను అధికారికంగా విడుదల చేసి వారి అనుభవాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்

programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
